# Antigravity App / CLI

Version: App 2.28.2 and CLI 1.4.12. Inspected 2026-11-02.

MCP file created by the official CLI mcp add. Permission file created by the unmodified App backend through its own UI RPC, offline in a Linux network namespace. No sign-in or model call.

Upstream: https://antigravity.google/docs/permissions

The generated hostname, lab-specific absolute paths and the lab Fastctx server key have been normalized. The server is named `lab-existing` here so the round-trip also checks that a neighboring service survives. No real credentials, accounts or machine names are included. The fixture tests configuration editing, not an authenticated model round-trip.
